name: Razer Seiren V3 Pro
notes: pid 0x058E, usagePage 0xFF53 (Razer audio). Send channel: HID interface 3, report 0x07, Feature, 64 data bytes (the Razer 'Device25' control report - see docs/PROTOCOL.md §5). Sidetone turned out to be USB-Audio-Class, so monitorOn/monitorOff stay null; the app does software monitoring instead. Lighting (12-LED Chroma ring) is fully supported over this channel and is built into the app - it needs no bytes here.
